From: dev.patel@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SSO - initial info request

Laura — quick technical triage below. Attaching the latest audit log spec for reference.

What we can provide now (hosted):
- Audit logs: exportable admin + API request logs (timestamped, request id, model, route, token counts). Exports available via Console (CSV) or via API (JSON). Default retention: 90 days for hosted accounts; we can produce ad-hoc exports beyond that for audit purposes.
- SSO: SAML-based SSO available today; SCIM provisioning is planned but not yet GA for hosted customers. Target for SCIM for hosted: Q3 2026 (ETA depends on QA).

What requires Dedicated/Private or roadmap work:
- BYOK/KMS: Full BYOK (customer-managed keys encrypting at rest for model inputs) is only supported on Redwood Private and Dedicated with our KMS integration layer. For hosted, we offer envelope encryption and rotating server-side keys; customers cannot currently bring their own master key in hosted. Roadmap: BYOK for hosted is a product initiative scoped for H2 2026; we can offer an exception path for enterprise customers via a limited-hosted BYOK beta if legal + infra approve.
- Retention per-account config: Hosted consoles allow retention toggles for logs up to 365 days via request, but fine-grained per-token retention control is a roadmap item.

Attachments: Redwood_Audit_Log_Spec_v1.pdf (details field names and sample export).

Risks / blockers:
- BYOK for hosted requires KMS integration and additional audit hooks; if Acme requires BYOK before PO, we'll need a documented exception + timeline and possibly a Dedicated deployment.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Share Audit Log Spec with Acme (attached).
2) Offer Dedicated trial instance for Acme if BYOK/KMS is a gating item.
3) Monica to propose commercial terms; legal to review exception wording.

— Dev Patel
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Audit_Log_Spec_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SSO - initial info request

Laura / Dev — quick note from legal/compliance perspective.

1) SOC 2: We have an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report (report and bridge letter). We can share a redacted copy via secure link; will require an NDA for full evidence.

2) BYOK exceptions: If Acme absolutely requires customer-managed keys for hosted, we should pursue the Dedicated offering or a private deployment. For a hosted exception (beta), we need:
   - Signed addendum specifying scope of keys and limited support window
   - Acceptance of additional operational constraints (e.g., ingestion windows, maintenance outage windows)
   - Defined rollback and data-escrow procedures

3) Retention & audit exports: We can commit to producing exports for audits beyond default retention as a contractual SLA item, but automated per-account retention (sub-30-day) is product work. We should avoid over-committing. Recommend: offer automated exports for 90/180/365 days, with ad-hoc export support for older data on request for the first contract year.

I'll draft a short addendum template and suggested language (will attach draft in next message).

— Markus Klein
Director, Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference
